name: Qwen Image Edit - Image Editing
description: Edit photos with plain-text prompts using Qwen

paragraphs: Edit photos with plain text using this AI image editor built on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and fast LoRAs. Describe the change you want, upload an image, and get an edited result in seconds. It handles background cleanup, relighting, object removal, restoration, and creative transformations, all driven by a simple text prompt so you can edit photos without masks or manual selections.

The space bundles specialized LoRA adapters for photo-to-anime conversion, multiple angles and views of the same subject, relighting, anime-to-photoreal conversion, shadow removal, unblurring, and stylized looks like Pixar-inspired 3D, noir comic panels, and Polaroid photos. Turn a portrait into anime, rotate the camera to see new angles, relight a scene, or sharpen a blurry shot, all from one AI image editing model.
